call.transcript:
AI Assistant: BrightSmile Dental, how can I help you today?
Caller: Hi, my name is Marcus Vance. I am calling because I have a missing tooth on the lower right and I want to schedule a dental implant consultation.
AI Assistant: We would be glad to help, Marcus! Our dental implant consultations include a 3D CBCT scan. When would you prefer to come in?
Caller: Next Tuesday morning around 10am would be great. My phone number is 555-349-8812.
AI Assistant: Perfect, I have your request noted for next Tuesday morning and our patient coordinator will call you back at 555-349-8812 to confirm your operatory slot.
Caller: Thank you, bye!
